in_marathi.name: Ikshita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligence, Vision, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ikshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ikshita means 'desired, longed for, wished for' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'iksh' which means 'to see' or 'to desire'. The name symbolizes intelligence, vision, and prosperity.
